description: Machine-readable register of Underlay component parity gaps identified for Poodle g04 implementation.

gaps.description: Focused modal for destructive-action confirmation with tone-colored confirm button, title, description, and keyboard dismiss.

gaps.sourcePattern: Underlay FormDialog combining Dialog + form layout
gaps.description: Modal dialog with embedded form fields, inline validation, submit/cancel actions, and loading state.
Wraps any trigger element with a confirmation prompt (popover or inline) before executing a dangerous action.

gaps.sourcePattern: Underlay FileUpload with drag-drop and preview
gaps.description: File input with drag-and-drop zone, file type filtering, size limits, upload progress, and thumbnail previews.
Poodle now covers the lightweight local selector plus reusable browse/status sub-surfaces; the callback-driven media-library workflow shell remains intentionally retained in Underlay.
URL input with paste detection, provider resolution, and preview generation for embedded content.
Rich card rendering for embedded content with provider icon, title, description, thumbnail, and link.
Primary action button with chevron-triggered dropdown menu of secondary actions.
Radio-selection group rendered as rich cards with title, description, icon, and visual selection indicator.
Add split variant prop to Button for use alongside SplitButton component.

gaps.sourcePattern: Underlay card radio-selection and specialized variants
gaps.description: Add selected/selectable props for radio contexts and specialized card layout variants (media-top, horizontal, compact).
Add prefix/suffix slots, async validation with debounce and loading indicator, and character count display.
Inline text that toggles between display and edit modes on click, with save on Enter/blur and cancel on Escape.
Add span and gridArea props for CSS grid column spanning in multi-column form layouts.
Displays relative timestamps that auto-update on a configurable interval with absolute-time tooltip.
Segmented input for hours/minutes/seconds with keyboard increment/decrement and min/max constraints.
List with drag-handle reordering, drop indicators, keyboard reorder support, and onReorder callback.
Self-managing list with inline add/remove/reorder and inline text editing per item.
Sort-control toolbar with field buttons, direction indicators, single/multi-sort, and reset.
Syntax-highlighted code display with line numbers, line highlighting, copy button, and overflow handling.

gaps.sourcePattern: Underlay ColorPicker with swatches and input
gaps.description: Color selection with color area, hue slider, text input, swatch palette, and hex/rgb/hsl format support.
Clickable card for navigation with title, description, icon, badge, and hover/focus styling.

gaps.sourcePattern: Underlay NavCardGrid grid of navigation cards
gaps.description: Responsive grid layout container for NavCard items with column config and breakpoints.
Structured list item card with leading icon/avatar, title, subtitle, metadata slots, and trailing action.
Add data-shape presets (table-row, card, list-item, detail-section, avatar-line) for common loading layouts.
Full-viewport loading overlay with spinner or progress bar, status message, and optional cancel.

gaps.sourcePattern: Underlay DataTable CSV export and column visibility
gaps.description: Add CSV export action, column visibility toggle menu, and multi-column sort indicators.
Add option group support with non-selectable heading labels and ARIA role=group semantics.
Timestamped event/log list with level-based color coding, filtering, auto-scroll, and search.

gaps.sourcePattern: Underlay StateTile trend indicators and sparklines
gaps.description: Add trend prop (up/down/flat) with directional arrow, trendLabel, and optional sparkline data array.
Markdown authoring with formatting toolbar, preview toggle, split-view mode, and image upload integration.
Audio playback with transport controls, seek bar, volume, duration display, and playback speed.
Video playback with overlay controls, seek, volume, fullscreen, poster image, and captions.
Enhanced relation picker with richer selection UI and multi-relation support.
Block-based content editor with paragraph, heading, image, code, quote, list, and divider blocks. Feasibility TBD.

nonGoals.reason: App-specific authentication patterns tied to Underlay's backend. Not portable as generic UI components.
Block editor plugin system, block-type registry, and serialization engine are Underlay-specific. Only the user-facing editor surface is in scope (g04.015).
Data fetching hooks, API client wrappers, and Underlay-specific store patterns are app-level concerns, not UI components.
Underlay uses Svelte 5.x runes syntax. Poodle targets Svelte 4.x. Runes migration is a separate concern from component parity.
Underlay layout components (HStack, VStack, Grid, etc.) already have Poodle equivalents (Inline, Stack, Grid, Box).
